m: वैगलेय m. (with गण) N. of a class of evil spirits, Hariv.
वैगन्धिका f. (fr. वि-गन्ध) a species of plant, Car. (prob. mc. for विग्˚).
वैग्रहिक mf(ई)n. belonging to the body, corporeal, bodily, MW.
वैग्रेय m. patr. fr. विग्र, g. शुभ्रादि.

s: klI, (viguRasya BAvaH । viguRa + zyaY .) viguRatvam । viguRasya BAvaH । yaTA, -- “yAtrApavarttate yugyaM vEguRyAt prAjakasya ca । tatra svAmI BaveddaRqyo hiMsAyAM dbiSataM damaH ॥” manuH ।
v: na॰ vigato virudDo vA guRo'sya tasya BAvaH zyaY । yatra yaducitaM tasya 1 rUpAntaratApAdane 2 anyAyatve 3 asampannatve ca ।
m: वैगुण्य n. (fr. वि-गुण) absence of or freedom from qualities, absence of attributes, W.
difference of qualities, contrariety of properties, diversity, W.
imperfection, defectiveness (with जन्मनः, ‘inferiority of birth’), ŚrS.; Mn. &c.
a: वैगुण्यं — [विगुणस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Absence of qualities or attributes. --2 Absence of good qualities, a defect, fault, an imperfection. --3 Difference of properties, diversity, contrariety. --4 Inferiority, lowness. --5 Unskilfulness.
